cards.name: Amazoness Chain Master - Brink of Death Chain Dance
cards.desc: If this card is sent to the GY and you have another "Amazoness" monster in your GY: You can pay 1000 LP; your opponent can choose 1 Level 10 monster in their Deck or Extra Deck, and if they do, you can Special Summon it to your field, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but neither player can activate its effects this turn. If they do not, you discard 1 random card from their hand. You can only use this effect of "Amazoness Chain Master - Brink of Death Chain Dance" once per turn.

If they do not, you discard 1 random card from their hand. You can only use this effect of "Amazoness Chain Master - Brink of Death Chain Dance" once per turn.

cards.name: Amazoness Spellcaster - Forbidden Spell Dance
cards.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Amazoness" monster from your Deck to your hand, except a Level 3 monster. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 EARTH or WIND Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. During damage calculation, if your "Amazoness" monster battles an opponent's monster: You can banish this card from your GY; switch the battling monsters' ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Amazoness Spellcaster - Forbidden Spell Dance" once per turn.

cards.name: Ashtrama Yoami
cards.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned, or sent from the field to the GY: You can add to your hand, or Set, 1 "Ashtra" Trap from your Deck. If you have a Trap in your GY: You can return as many face-down cards on the field as possible to the hand, then if you have 5 or more Traps in your GY, you can return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Ashtrama Yoami" once per turn.

cards.name: Teardrop the Rikka Empress
cards.desc:
2 Level 10 Plant monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using "Teardrop the Rikka Queen" you control (transfer its materials). (Quick Effect): You can detach up to 6 materials from this card; send that many Spells/Traps on the field to the GY, then you can Tribute 1 monster on the field. You can only use this effect of "Teardrop the Rikka Empress" once per turn. Each time a monster(s) is Tributed: Attach 1 card from your opponent's GY to 1 Plant Xyz Monster you control.

cards.name: Harpie & Amazoness Rakshasa Formation
cards.desc:
You can only activate 1 card with this card's name per turn.
①：Target 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it, then you can apply 1 of these effects based on the number of "Harpie Lady" monsters and "Amazoness" monsters you control.
● 1+: Place 1 "Eyelluring Mirror Wall" from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone.
● 2+: Take control of 1 monster your opponent controls.
● 3+: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

cards.name: Power of the Duelist
cards.desc:
Declare 2, 3, or 4 Attributes; apply this effect based on the number declared, also during the End Phase of this turn, you must send all cards you control to the GY, unless you have activated effects of monsters of all declared Attributes in your field and/or GY this turn.
● 2: Target 1 monster on the field; banish it.
● 3: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
● 4: Negate the effects of 2 face-up cards on the field.
You can only activate 1 "Power of the Duelist" per turn.

cards.name: Eyelluring Mirror Wall
cards.desc:
①：Gains these effects while you control an "Amazoness" monster or "Harpie Lady" monster.
● Face-up monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position and must attack if able.
● Once per battle, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can halve its ATK.
②：Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: You can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your GY or banishment that mentions "Harpie Lady", except "Eyelluring Mirror Wall".
